        public LanguageServerClient(JsonRpcPeer peer, JsonSerializerOptions? options = null, JsonRpcParamStyle defaultParamStyle = JsonRpcParamStyle.ByPosition)
        {

            _options = options ?? JsonRpcSerializer.DefaultOptions;

        private JsonRpcParams? BuildParams(JsonRpcParamStyle style, string[] names, object?[] values, bool[] optional)
        {
            if (names.Length == 0)
                return null;

            if (style == JsonRpcParamStyle.ByName)
            {
                var named = new List<KeyValuePair<string, object?>>();

                for (var i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
                {
                    if (!(optional[i] && values[i] is null))
                        named.Add(new KeyValuePair<string, object?>(names[i], values[i]));
                }

                return JsonRpcParams.ByName(_options, named);
            }

            // By position: trailing optional values that were not supplied are left off.
            var count = values.Length;

            while (count > 0 && optional[count - 1] && values[count - 1] is null)
                count--;

            var positional = new List<object?>(count);

            for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
                positional.Add(values[i]);

            return JsonRpcParams.ByPosition(_options, positional);
        }

        private static T? Pushed<T>(JsonElement? @params, int position, string name, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            JsonElement? value = null;

            if (@params is { ValueKind: JsonValueKind.Array } array)
            {
                if (position < array.GetArrayLength())
                    value = array[position];
            }
            else if (@params is { ValueKind: JsonValueKind.Object } obj && obj.TryGetProperty(name, out var named))
            {
                value = named;
            }

            return value is { ValueKind: not JsonValueKind.Null } present ? present.Deserialize<T>(options) : default;
        }
